messages.text: I’ll check the completed ledgers, reported statistics and provenance at the exact result commit, including the boundary-loss accounting and the limits on the conclusions.

The independent calculations agree with the report. The complete-deposit width improvement remains after accounting for unassigned energy, and a separate 1,000-replicate resampling reproduces the reported intervals and joint covariance to numerical precision. The conclusion remains limited to this conditional ECAL gap study.

**LAR-GAP10K-PhysVal-final — no actionable findings** for the bounded result at **`777452601a742aa267f63c2cfd37d71aba830893`**.

Independently reproduced the complete-deposit results:

| Region | 800 mm width | 400 mm width | Paired difference, 95% interval |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| All 10,000 primaries | 17.84% | 13.56% | −4.29 pp [−4.80, −3.78] |
| Fixed 999-primary transition | 44.18% | 21.00% | −23.19 pp [−25.93, −20.60] |

Fixed-cut tails fall from **183 to zero** in both populations. These estimates and their interpretation match the [report]([redacted]

Actual independent checks:

- Rehashed both derived ledgers/proofs and checked source/helper, library, sample, native-ledger, map and worker bindings.
- Verified all event/collection closure bounds and exact retained per-event primary/saved-signal replay.
- Recomputed **all** A/H projection moments, denominators, zeros, tails and U metrics.
- Independently repeated 1,000 direct-index bootstrap replicates for global, broad, |η| and fine-transition observables. Maximum interval-endpoint discrepancy: **9.72×10⁻¹⁴**.
- Reproduced the explicitly ordered **84-variable covariance**; maximum element discrepancy: **8.64×10⁻¹⁷**.

Unassigned deposits total **1.188391019896783 MeV** standard and **0.14899656686392543 MeV** candidate, affecting three and two primaries respectively. The resulting change to the global gap-width contrast is approximately **0.00000336 percentage points**. Missing deposits and output quantization do not explain the observed improvement.

The conclusion is supported for this **conditional ECAL-only raw-deposit comparison**. The report appropriately retains the unresolved canonical-cell assignment issue, pointwise statistical limitations, and absent engineering/systematic qualification. Zero observed tails do not exclude a nonzero population rate.

No files changed; no native simulation ran. I reviewed the full-cell replay proof and its source/bindings without independently reparsing the ROOT cell payloads or repeating visual QA.
